items.title: Compound nomenclature and surface connectivity
items.text: Compound 1 is QDOH: CdS nanoclusters capped by sulfur-bound 4-hydroxythiophenolate. Compounds 2a–e retain that cap and esterify its phenolic oxygen with acetyl, butanoyl, pyrene-1-carbonyl, benzoyl and decanoyl groups, respectively. Compounds 3a–e are the corresponding N-acylimidazole reagents. The unnumbered drawing is a schematic surface representation, not an atom-resolved structure or a counted ligand shell.
